= a2q6 |quest_reward2_act = 2 |quest_reward2_class_ids = Shadow,Templar,Witch |quest_reward2_npc = Yeena }} '''Galvanic Field''' is a [[spell]] that grants a [[buff]] which grants additional [[shock]] chance when cast. Upon shocking an enemy, the buff is removed to attach an electric field around the target, which hits a random enemy within its [[area of effect]] to deal [[lightning damage]] for a [[duration]]. The field has increased area of effect and damage based on the magnitude of the shock that was applied. ==Skill functions and interactions== * While this skill has the Area tag, only the area of the field can be modified. The damage dealt by the field is not affected by Area damage. * It is possible to apply a Galvanic Field to yourself by inflicting shock on yourself via {{il|Storm Secret}} or [[self-damage]] with {{c|mod|Physical Damage taken as Lightning}}.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FU00lOq1NKE ** You will require sources of Chance to be Shocked, such as from {{il|Replica Reckless Defence}}, {{il|Font of Thunder}}, or self-curse {{il|Conductivity}}. ** [[Lightning Mastery]] and {{il|Voltaxic Rift}} can increase the maximum shock cap on you. ** Galvanic Field's damage and radius scaling is dependent on the shock directly affecting the player; {{c|mod|Unaffected by Shock}} will cause these stats to not work. Therefore, it is necessary to build additional defences to account for the increased damage taken. * {{c|mod|Each enemy can only be targeted once every (0.70–0.50) seconds}}: This applies to both direct targeting and hits caused by chaining. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Lightning
